missions.title: Word on the Street
missions.intro: Boeta pulls you aside: "We need to talk about the Tortel Laaities."
missions.description: The Tortel Laaities want a sit-down.

objectives.text: Go and look at the Tortel corner

missions.title: The Sit-Down
missions.intro: Marlon Carelse: "You wanted to talk. Talk."

missions.title: Send a Message
missions.intro: Boeta: "Tonight we stand on their corner. All of us. Let them see."
missions.description: Hold the Tortel corner at night with your crew.

objectives.text: Hold the Tortel corner with your crew after dark

missions.title: East of the Gate
missions.intro: Spider: "Got a minute? Not here. Walk with me."
missions.description: The Dune Cruisers make an offer.

missions.title: The Market Cut
missions.intro: Uncle Faried: "Sit, sit. Have a naartjie. We need to talk about money."
missions.description: Decide what the market pays you.

missions.title: Kings of the Plain
missions.intro: Boeta: "Westridge, Lentegeur, the Promenade... People say our name now. One more push and the Plain is ours."

intro_by_flag.market_cut: Boeta: "The market pays us, the block fears us. One more push and the Plain is ours, the hard way."
intro_by_flag.market_free: Boeta: "The aunties at the market wave at us now. One more push and the Plain is ours, and they'll be glad of it."

missions.description: Hold six corners across Mitchells Plain.

objectives.text: Hold six corners across Mitchells Plain
